verses.text: Around that time, Judah left his brothers and went to stay with an Adullamite named Hirah. 🧭
There Judah met the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He married her and slept with her. 💍
She became pregnant and gave birth to a son. Judah named him Er. 👶
She became pregnant again, gave birth to another son, and named him Onan. 👶
She had one more son and named him Shelah. He was born at Chezib. 👶
Judah arranged a wife for his firstborn son Er. Her name was Tamar. 💍
Er, Judah’s firstborn, did what was evil in the LORD’s sight, so the LORD put him to death. ⚖️
Judah told Onan, “Go to your brother’s wife. Do your duty as his brother-in-law and give your brother a child.” 📜
Onan knew the child wouldn’t count as his. So whenever he slept with his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground to keep his brother from having descendants. ⚠️
What Onan did was evil in the LORD’s sight, so the LORD put him to death too. ⚖️

Judah told his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Go live as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up.” He was afraid Shelah might die like his brothers. Tamar went and lived with her father. 🏠
After a long time, Judah’s wife—the daughter of Shua—died. Once Judah had finished mourning, he went with his friend Hirah the Adullamite to Timnah, where his sheep were being sheared. 🐑
Someone told Tamar, “Your father-in-law is heading to Timnah to shear his sheep.” 🐑

She changed out of her widow’s clothes, covered herself with a veil, wrapped up, and sat at Enaim’s entrance on the road to Timnah. She knew Shelah had grown up, but she still hadn’t been given to him as a wife. 🧕
Judah saw her and assumed she was a prostitute because her face was veiled. 👀
He stepped over and said, “Come on, let me sleep with you.” He didn’t know she was his daughter-in-law. She asked, “What will you give me?” 💬
He said, “I’ll send you a young goat from my flock.” She replied, “Will you leave me something as a pledge until you send it?” 🐐
He asked, “What pledge do you want?” She said, “Your seal, its cord, and the staff in your hand.” He gave them to her, slept with her, and she became pregnant by him. 🔖
Then she got up, left, removed her veil, and put her widow’s clothes back on. 🧕
Judah sent the young goat with his Adullamite friend to get his pledge back from the woman, but his friend couldn’t find her. 🐐
He asked the men there, “Where’s the prostitute who was sitting by the road at Enaim?” They answered, “There hasn’t been a prostitute here.” 🤷
He went back to Judah and said, “I couldn’t find her. The men there also said no prostitute had been there.” 🗣️
Judah said, “Let her keep the things. We don’t need to become a joke over this. I sent the young goat, but you couldn’t find her.” 🤐
About three months later, someone told Judah, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has been acting like a prostitute, and now she’s pregnant.” Judah said, “Bring her out and burn her.” ⚠️
As they brought her out, Tamar sent this message to her father-in-law: “I’m pregnant by the man who owns these. Please identify whose seal, cord, and staff these are.” 🔖
Judah recognized them and said, “She is more in the right than I am, because I didn’t give her to my son Shelah.” He never slept with her again. ⚖️
When Tamar was giving birth, it turned out she had twins in her womb. 👶👶
As she labored, one baby put out a hand. The midwife tied a scarlet thread around it and said, “This one came out first.” 🧵
But he pulled his hand back, and his brother came out first. The midwife said, “What a breach you’ve made for yourself!” So they named him Perez. 👶
Then his brother came out, with the scarlet thread still on his hand. They named him Zerah. 🧵
